description: This file defines an Angular service 'MenuService' responsible for managing application menu sections, user navigation, and related data, utilizing NgRx store and Angular router.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Angular service for handling menu sections, user navigation, and menu-related data.

methods.name: buildMenu
methods.description: Builds the menu based on authentication state and updates menu sections.

methods.name: updateOpenedMenuSections
methods.description: Updates the 'opened' state of menu sections based on current URL and store data.

methods.name: allMenuLinks
methods.description: Recursively collects all menu link sections from a list of menu sections.

methods.name: allMenuSections
methods.description: Recursively collects all menu sections from a list of menu sections.

methods.name: menuSections
methods.description: Returns an observable of current menu sections.

methods.name: homeSections
methods.description: Returns an observable of home sections.

methods.name: availableMenuLinks
methods.description: Returns an observable of available menu link sections.

methods.name: availableMenuSections
methods.description: Returns an observable of available menu sections.

methods.name: menuLinkById
methods.description: Finds a menu link by its ID.

methods.name: menuLinksByIds
methods.description: Finds multiple menu links by their IDs.
